prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 家常红烧肉配料表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 9 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "食材" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 40px
  col 2: header "用量（克）" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 67px
  col 3: header "处理方式" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 208px
  col 4: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 160px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"A kitchen reference card: eight ingredients for 家常红烧肉, each with a quantity and a short prep instruction plus an advisory note. It is consulted mid-cooking, not read as prose, so lookup speed and unambiguous quantities matter more than compactness.","reading":"Vertical scan down col 1 to locate an ingredient, then a short rightward hop to its amount, then the prep instruction, then optionally the note. Comparison happens down the amount column (500 vs 15 vs 5) and across the two prose columns, which are read only one row at a time. Rows are the unit, so every row should keep its four cells visually on the same band and prose should wrap rather than push a row apart.","groups":["col 1 + col 2: ingredient and its quantity are one measure unit ('what' + 'how much') and must be read together, so they should stay narrow and adjacent with no wrapping between them","col 3 + col 4: both are free prose; 处理方式 is the operative instruction, 备注 is secondary/advisory, so they may be traded against each other but not against cols 1–2"],"keep_intact":["ingredient names in col 1 (五花肉, 大葱, 冰糖 …) — never break a 2–3 character name","all amounts in col 2: 500, 15, 20, 25, 30, 5 and the words 适量 / 少许 must sit on one line","the header 用量（克） should stay unbroken so the unit is not orphaned from the number it qualifies","numeral+unit tokens inside prose such as 3厘米 and 两次 should not be split mid-token"],"may_wrap":["处理方式 sentences (切3厘米见方块，冷水下锅焯净血沫 / 焯水和炖煮时分两次加入) — 2 lines is acceptable","备注 sentences (选肥瘦三层分明的五花肉 / 老姜去腥效果更好) — advisory, can absorb 2–3 lines without hurting the lookup","the header 处理方式 / 备注 may wrap only as a last resort; both fit at 27px unbreakable"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [61, 88, 173, 157] · table 480×360px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 53, 53, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [61, 88, 171, 159] · table 480×360px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 53, 53, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"食材和用量紧邻，名称、数值及带单位的表头均保持完整；处理方式与备注的层级清楚，各行也容易横向对应。没有词中拆分，最长单元格为两行。","problems":"五花肉备注的末字“肉”和大葱备注的末字“量”各自落到第二行，形成明显的零散短行；冰糖备注也只把“过大”留在第二行。","cause":"备注列宽157px，扣除内边距和边框后正文宽136px，略不足以容纳这些句子。处理方式列173px则让五花肉的操作说明保持在两行。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"保留了r2A清晰的食材—用量组合、完整表头和整行对应关系；全部内容仍控制在两行内，无词中拆分。","problems":"整体换行与r2A几乎相同，备注中的孤字和短尾行仍然存在，因此视觉节奏没有明显改善。","cause":"备注列只从157px增加到159px，增加的2px不足以跨过这些句子的换行阈值；处理方式列相应减少2px，也没有带来可见收益。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"备注优先","widths":[61,88,160,170],"change":"保持食材和用量的最小完整宽度，将13px从处理方式移给备注，测试能否消除备注中的孤字和短尾行，同时观察最长操作说明是否仍能控制在两行。"},{"name":"均衡正文","widths":[61,88,165,165],"change":"让两列正文各占165px，在操作说明的可读性和备注的换行之间寻找折中，并检查备注的孤字是否因此消失。"},{"name":"操作优先","widths":[61,88,183,147],"change":"将10px从备注移给处理方式，探索更宽的操作列能否改善关键步骤的断行；同时检查较窄的备注是否产生过多短行或第三行。"}]}
